articles.title: Woman stabbed, suspect arrested in Oakwood Village
articles.summary: A woman has been taken to hospital and a suspect was arrested after a stabbing in Oakwood Village Tuesday afternoon. articles.title: Bombardier to buy Mitsubishi aerospace plant near Pearson airport
articles.summary: MONTREAL — Bombardier Inc. says it will buy Mitsubishi's main Canadian aerospace factory, bringing in-house an operation that was previously outsourced.

articles.title: Woman killed in Times Square stabbing worked for Bank of America
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — The woman killed in a random stabbing in Times Square was a Bank of America employee, the bank confirmed Tuesday. Police identified her and the attacker, who was killed in a confrontation with officers shortly after the rampage.

articles.title: Inquest set for 88-year-old who died after well-being check by Peel police in 2023
articles.summary: An inquest will be held next week into the death of an 88-year-old man who died after he fell down a flight of stairs during a well-being check by Peel police in Mississauga nearly three years ago.

articles.title: Ontario's new cash bail system on hold after judge grants injunction
articles.summary: Ontario's new cash bail system has been put on hold while a judge weighs a challenge to its constitutionality.

articles.title: Disbarred Brampton lawyer charged in alleged $4.3M fraud scheme: Peel police
articles.summary: A disbarred Brampton lawyer has been arrested and charged with allegedly orchestrating four mortgage and cheque fraud schemes totaling around $4.3-million, Peel police say.

articles.title: Liberals win federal byelection in Beaches-East York
articles.summary: Liberal Tanveer Shahnawaz has won the federal byelection in the Toronto riding of Beaches-East York, maintaining the party's stronghold in the riding.
